mapper.select: SELECT id, org_id, owner_user_id, name, state::text AS state, updated_at FROM map_project WHERE org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO map_project (org_id, owner_user_id, name, state) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{name}, CAST(#{state} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE map_project SET name = #{name}, state = CAST(#{state} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM map_project WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO map_share (project_id, token, password_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{token}, #{passwordHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.token, s.project_id, s.password_hash, s.expires_at, p.name, p.state::text AS state FROM map_share s JOIN map_project p ON p.id = s.project_id WHERE s.token = #{token}
